description: The audio has Linguistic/Paralinguistic artifacts, as the shorthand notations like “U.N.” and “No.10” are pronounced incorrectly or in an awkward, non-natural manner, indicating mispronounced words.
The audio exhibits Voice-Quality artifacts characterized by an Unnatural Voice Timbre, with a distinctly synthetic voice quality that sounds artificial and lacks natural human resonance.
The audio contains Signal-level artifacts in the form of Background Noise, specifically noticeable static noise that interferes with the clarity of the speech signal.
The audio demonstrates Temporal/Prosodic artifacts due to a Lack of Expressiveness, where the emotionally charged and surprised tone of the sentence is delivered in a flat or monotonous manner.

The audio shows Articulation Related artifacts involving Poor Word Articulation, as certain words such as “carbonic acid” are distorted or imprecisely formed, reducing intelligibility despite clear word boundaries.
The audio contains Temporal/Prosodic artifacts marked by Awkward Pauses, where unnatural and frequent breaks disrupt the natural flow of the sentence and affect its conversational rhythm.
